Contact.title: Send a message
Contact.description: Do you have a project in mind or specific needs? I would be delighted to discuss it with you. Open to all collaboration proposals — whether for freelance, hybrid or internship missions, or any other opportunity — I am committed to providing solutions tailored to your expectations. Feel free to contact me via the form below or by email. Looking forward to hearing from you!

errors.nameMinLength: Name should be at least 3 characters long.
errors.messageMaxLength: Message should be less than 500 characters
errors.messageMinLength: Message should be more than 50 characters

toast.success: Message sent! I'll get back to you soon.
toast.error: Something went wrong, please try again.
